blocks.text: Pani bohat si cheezon ko dissolve (hal) kar leta hai. Is ki wajah us ki do properties hain: pani ke molecules ki polarity (dono siron par mukhtalif charge), aur pani ke molecules ki hydrogen bonds banane ki salahiyat.

Pani ke molecule ke do alag sire hain aur har sire par partial (thora sa) charge hai. Hydrogen atom par thora positive aur oxygen atom par thora negative charge hota hai. Aise molecules ko polar molecules kehte hain.
Hydrogen bonds proteins ki three-dimensional (3D) structure aur DNA ke double helix ko qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain.

Ek pani ke molecule ke negative sire ko doosre pani ke molecule ka positive sira apni taraf khenchta hai. Is kamzor kashish (attraction) ko hydrogen bond kehte hain. Pani mein aise bonds ka ek jaal (network) ban jata hai. Pani ki bohat si properties inhi hydrogen bonds ki wajah se hain.
Agar hydrogen bonding na hoti to pani – 80 °C par ubalta aur – 100 °C par jam jata, yani aam darja-e-hararat (temperature) par pani hamesha gas hota aur zindagi mumkin na hoti.

blocks.alt: Beech mein pani ka ek molecule (O aur do H) aur us ke gird chaar molecules. Nuqta-daar (dotted) hydrogen bonds beech wale molecule ke har H ko padosi ke O se, aur us ke O ko do aur padosiyon ke H se jorte hain. O siron par (-) aur H siron par (+) hai; ek bond par Hydrogen bond likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.6: Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds (kitab ki Figure 4.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Charge wale ya polar molecules, jaise salts, sugars aur amino acids, pani mein aasani se hal ho jate hain, is liye inhein hydrophilic (“pani pasand”) kehte hain. Be-charge ya non-polar molecules, jaise lipids, pani mein hal nahin hote aur inhein hydrophobic (“pani se door bhagne wale”) kehte hain.

Polar hone ki wajah se pani ke molecules har us molecule ke gird jama ho jate hain jis par electrical charge ho, chahe poora charge ho (ions) ya thora sa charge (polar molecules). Maslan jab sodium chloride (namak) pani mein dala jata hai to yeh positive (Na⁺) aur negative (Cl⁻) ions mein toot jata hai. Har ion ko pani ke molecules apne ulte charge wale sire se gher lete hain (Figure 4.7).

blocks.alt: Baayen: NaCl ka crystal, bare hare Cl- aur chhote jamni Na+ ions ki ghani tarteeb. Teer hal shuda ions ki taraf: har Na+ ke gird pani ke molecules apna O sira us ki taraf kiye hain, aur har Cl- ke gird molecules apna H sira us ki taraf kiye hain. Labels: NaCl, Na+, Cl-.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.7: Inorganic molecules (NaCl) ke liye pani bator solvent (kitab ki Figure 4.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani ka O sira thora negative aur H sire thore positive hain. Is liye positive Na⁺ ki taraf pani ke molecules apna O sira karte hain, aur negative Cl⁻ ki taraf apna H sira. Har ion ke gird pani ka yeh ghera ions ko dobara milne nahin deta, aur namak hal ho jata hai.

Isi tarah jab glucose pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules glucose ke polar hydroxyl (OH) groups se hydrogen bonds bana lete hain, aur yun glucose pani mein hal ho jata hai (Figure 4.8). Matlab charge wale ya polar molecules pani mein hal ho jate hain. Solution (mahlool) ki halat mein ions aur molecules aasani se aapas mein react kar sakte hain. Is liye pani chemical reactions, yani cells ke metabolism, ke liye medium (zariya) deta hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki ring (upar ring ka O, ek carbon par CH2OH aur baqi chaar par OH), aur har hydroxyl group ke paas pani ka ek molecule jo nuqta-daar hydrogen bond se jura hai. Labels: Glucose, Hydroxyl group, Hydrogen bond, Water.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.8: Organic molecules (glucose) ke liye pani bator solvent (kitab ki Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani charge wale ya polar molecules pani mein hal hote hain. Solution mein ions aur molecules aasani se react kar lete hain, is liye pani metabolism (cells ke andar chemical reactions) ka medium hai.

Polar molecules jaise salts, sugars aur amino acids pani mein jaldi hal hote hain aur hydrophilic (pani pasand) kehlate hain. Be-charge ya non-polar molecules jaise lipids pani mein hal nahin hote aur hydrophobic (pani se door rehne wale) kehlate hain. (Kitab yeh baat upar wale box mein bhi keh chuki hai.)
